title: Offline Skill prior from the archives (warm start): measured, not worth it
purpose: Serves purpose 1 (what is learnable from experience): can one offline pass over archived, diagnosed training failures produce rules that beat the public task card? Serves purpose 2 (generalisation): does a prior distilled from some items carry over to items it never saw? E8 tests carry-over to fresh items within the same benchmark; a prior that fails this cannot be expected to carry across benchmarks.
verdict_cn:
结论：不值得做。把旧实验的失败记录"离线提炼"成一份起步用的技能说明（"热启动"：技能说明是附加在答题模型提示里的一段文字），在两个测试集上都没有超过现成的任务卡说明，在财政公报问答上还更差。

做了什么：让出规则的模型 GLM-5.3 阅读 v3 实验留下的训练题失败记录，为每个测试集写最多 5 条"当……时：……；否则……"形式的规则，每条不超过 600 个字符。用到的失败记录：搜索问答（SearchQA）65 道失败题；财政公报表格问答（OfficeQA）74 道题分成两半，每半约 31 道失败题。然后让答题模型 deepseek-v4-flash 在规则没见过的训练题上比较三种说明：
- E：空白模板；
- I：根据公开任务卡写好的 12 条通用要点；
- D：空白模板加上提炼出的规则。
SearchQA 新抽 100 道题，每题答 2 遍。OfficeQA 只有 74 道训练题，所以用一半题的失败来提炼、在另一半上测，再反过来；因为预算只答 1 遍，完成了 67 道。共花约 302 万 token（token 是模型计算文字量的单位），全部是本方向较早一次运行花的。这次没有花钱，只做了复核和补充分析。

结果（方括号里是 95% 置信区间，即真实差值大概率所在的范围；"点"指百分点）：
1. SearchQA。按现有的评分程序，D 和 I 都答对 171/200（85.5%），差值 0［−3.7，+3.7］，都比空白模板（144/200）高 13.5 点。但 D 有 32 次回答没写答案标签 <answer>，其中 27 次是靠评分程序"找不到标签就取最后一行"的兜底才算对。按任务卡写明的规则（只看标签里的答案），D 只有 144/200：比 I 低 13.5 点［−19.9，−7.1］，和空白模板（141/200）差不多。
2. OfficeQA。D 答对 27/67（40.3%），空白模板 31/67（46.3%），任务卡要点 34/67（50.7%）。D 比 I 低 10.4 点［−22.6，+1.7］：统计上不显著，但在两半题目上方向一致。原因看得见：用一半题提炼的规则，让模型在另一半的 35 道题里有 26 次只输出"<answer>数字</answer>"而不写计算过程，这样的回答很少答对。

提炼出的规则长什么样：保留的 14 条全部是"当……时"的条件句，但条件很宽：模型自己估计中位数适用于一半的题，有两条其实对所有题都成立。按我的阅读，6 条只是换个说法重复任务卡要点，5 条在要点上加了具体做法，只有 3 条是新的。这些规则和 v3 在线学习时提出过、却全部没通过检验的规则几乎是同一批思路。新规则在新题上会用错，例如把正确答案"比利·鲍勃·桑顿"答成"比利·鲍勃·桑顿的妻子们"。

另一个重要发现：答题模型本身在两天之间变了。题目、说明和发出的请求内容都一样：10 月 20 日凌晨，它在 OfficeQA 上几乎只写答案（中位数 10 个 token），只答对 22%；10 月 21 日它会写出计算过程（中位数 175 个 token），答对 46%。所以旧失败记录已经"过期"：v3 里 42 道"四次都答错"的题，现在有 18 道能答对。从旧记录提炼的规则，针对的是一个已经不存在的模型行为。

建议：
- 下一版继续用任务卡要点 I 作为起点，不要用旧档案提炼的规则当起点。
- 如果以后还想用这种提炼，只能把结果当作"加在任务卡要点之上的一批候选规则"：用当周重新测得的失败来提炼，像其他规则一样通过检验，并检查它会不会让模型丢掉答案标签或不再写计算过程。
- 先修好 SearchQA 评分的"无标签兜底"。
- 所有比较只在同一时间段内交错运行，每次先用一小组固定题目检查答题模型有没有又变了。
已经准备好"任务卡要点加提炼规则"的后续测试脚本（SearchQA 约 170 万 token，OfficeQA 约 300 万 token）。它超出本次 300 万的预算，所以没有运行。
what_i_did:
1. Took over an interrupted earlier E8 run. It used the same scripts, wrote design.json before any paid call, distilled with GLM-5.3, and spent the whole 3M-token budget on 801 deepseek cells, but wrote no report. Its OfficeQA analysis had been written when only 8 cells existed.
2. Verified the artifacts and the hard rules:
   - training pools only: data.pool loads only the historical train and val parts;
   - 0 of the 232 SearchQA and 17 OfficeQA v8-v11 panel paths inspected carry a test/final/holdout label, and only the development and skill_confirmation partitions appear;
   - code byte-identical to the frozen v3 snapshot for every module used.
3. Re-ran the pre-registered paired analysis over all 801 cells.
4. Added free analyses:
   (a) SearchQA sensitivity under the card's rule that only the last answer tag counts. The repository scorer instead falls back to the reply's last line.
   (b) Cross-day drift on OfficeQA: v3 cells from 10-20 against E8 cells from 10-21, same items, same Skill digests, identical prompt-token counts.
   (c) Verification of the cross-fitting and evaluation/evidence disjointness on the cells.
   (d) Reply-form mechanisms, per-item flips, failure kinds, and same-day run-to-run noise.
   (e) Minimum detectable effects.
   (f) Inventory of the OfficeQA archives on the old machine.
   (g) Semantic mapping of every rule to the seed bullets (my reading) next to the earlier lexical overlap numbers.
5. Prepared, but did not launch, a follow-up arm: seeds plus distilled rules, with the seeds re-measured interleaved. Its free compose step is tested.
6. No API call was made in this session.
evidence:
All counts are measured.

SearchQA (100 fresh training items x 2 runs, 600 cells, 0 unknown):
- As scored: E 144/200, I 171/200, D 171/200.
  - D-I = 0.000, t95 [-0.037, +0.037]; 2 items up, 3 down, 95 tied; sign p = 1.0.
  - D-E = +0.135 [+0.074, +0.196]; 20/1.
  - I-E = +0.135 [+0.075, +0.195]; 21/1.
- D gave 32 untagged replies (27 passed via the scorer fallback); I gave 0.
- Under the card's tag rule: D 144, E 141, I 171.
  - D-I = -0.135 [-0.199, -0.071]; 1/21; p < 0.0001.
  - D-E = +0.015 [-0.070, +0.100]; 18/16.
  - I-E = +0.150 [+0.089, +0.211].
- Flips (rules visibly firing): SQ3 turned "Billy Bob Thornton" into "Billy Bob Thornton's wives" (2/2 runs); SQ1 cut "Lord Robert Baden-Powell" to "Baden-Powell".
- Same-day run disagreement: E 14/100 items, I 1/100, D 1/100.

OfficeQA (74-item pool, 2-fold cross-fitting, 1 run, 67 items):
- E 31/67, I 34/67, D 27/67.
  - D-I = -0.104 [-0.226, +0.017]; 5/12; p = 0.14.
  - D-E = -0.060 [-0.171, +0.052].
  - I-E = +0.045 [-0.045, +0.134].
- Fold B (D_A rules): D 10/35 vs I 16/35; D-I = -0.171 [-0.327, -0.016]; 1/7; p = 0.07.
- Bare tag-only replies on fold B: D 26/35, E 9/35, I 3/35.
- Replies of at most 30 tokens pass 6/30 (D), against 21/37 for D's longer replies.

Drift (same request, server-side change):
- OfficeQA E-scaffold: v3 (10-20 02:17) 29/134, median reply 10 tokens; E8 (10-21) 31/67, median 175; per item +0.246, 19 up / 1 down.
- OfficeQA seeds: 35/134 -> 34/67; +0.246, 20/3.
- SearchQA: cal-1 request hashes byte-identical to v3 (1,981/1,981 sends); E-scaffold median 10 -> 41 tokens, pass 74.3% -> 68.5% (35 items worse / 12 better).
- 18 of the 42 OfficeQA items that failed all 4 v3 runs are now solved by some arm.

Rules:
- 15 proposed, 1 dropped (mechanical 8-gram leak), 14 kept. All 15 use the conditional template.
- Claimed condition share: median 50%, range 20-95%.
- My mapping: 6 restate a seed bullet, 5 refine one, 3 new.
- Lexical containment, medians: closest card sentence 0.05; closest seed bullet 0.13; closest never-accepted v3 proposal 0.36 (max 0.66).
- 4 of 5 OfficeQA themes recur across the two independent folds (Jaccard 0.22-0.36 vs 0.02 between unrelated rules).
- 5 of 14 kept rules carry an evidence/code mismatch that v3's prepare step would void.

Detectable effect (80% power): SearchQA D-I 5.3 points at n = 100; OfficeQA D-I 17.0 points at n = 67 (774 items would be needed for 5 points).
design:
Pre-registered in /data/feasibility/E8/design.json (E8-design-v2, 2026-10-21 00:05), before any paid call.

Evidence:
- v3 E-ds and I-ds training cells with examiner diagnoses: SearchQA 200 items x 4 deepseek runs; OfficeQA 74 x 4.
- v1 GLM-5.3 outcomes on the same items, used as a "stronger solver solved it k of 4" signal.

Distiller:
- GLM-5.3 with v3 role settings, one call per (benchmark, fold), payload at most 200 KB: the task as the solver saw it, the reply, the reference, the failure code, run counts, code meanings, 4 correct contrasts.
- Asks for at most 5 rules of at most 600 characters in the template "When <observable condition>: <bounded action>; otherwise <default>", each with codes, evidence ids, covered/adds and a condition share. One re-ask was allowed (not needed).
- Leakage: v3's mechanical pool checks, then the registered adjudicator.

Arms:
- E: empty scaffold (v3 E-ds step 0).
- I: five task-card seeds (v3 I-ds step 0, 12,681 bytes).
- D: scaffold + kept rules (4.3-4.5 KB).

Evaluation:
- SearchQA: 100 items seeded from the 400 pool items outside v3's 200-item draw (60 train-part, 40 val-part; 0 overlap with evidence), 2 runs.
- OfficeQA: the whole 74-item pool, seeded into folds A/B, cross-fitted (D on fold-A items uses rules distilled from fold B and vice versa), 1 run because of the budget.
- deepseek-v4-flash through the frozen backends (contract-first-v2, temperature 0, 32,768 max tokens, thinking off), v3 decision table, arms interleaved per item, 3M-token cap.
- Analysis: paired per-item means; t and bootstrap 95% CIs (10,000 resamples, seed 20261017); exact sign test.
- Post-hoc sensitivity: the card's tag rule for SearchQA.

Prepared follow-up (scripts2/e8_arm_id.py): arm ID = seeds + the same rules (16.4-16.6 KB), compared with I re-measured interleaved on the same items, 2 runs, with its own cap and cell directory, so cross-day drift cannot bias it.

pilot.result: Ran (paid part executed by the earlier E8 instance on 2026-10-21 00:05-01:18; re-analysed and extended for free in this session). 3 GLM distillation calls + 14 adjudications; 801 deepseek cells (SearchQA 600 complete; OfficeQA 201 of 222, stopped by the 3M cap: 7 items x 3 arms not run). Outcome: distilled Skill D = task-card seeds I on SearchQA only as scored (171/200 each; under the card's tag rule D 144 vs I 171, D-I -0.135 [-0.199, -0.071]); on OfficeQA D 27/67 < E 31/67 < I 34/67 (D-I -0.104 [-0.226, +0.017]). Mechanism: form rules, dropped answer tags (32/200), and bare tag-only answers on OfficeQA (26/35 on fold B). Side finding: server-side solver drift between 10-20 and 10-21 (OfficeQA same request, pass 21.6% -> 46.3%, median reply 10 -> 175 tokens).
pilot.command: Follow-up, prepared and not launched. SearchQA, ~1.7M tokens: ssh -o BatchMode=yes <datatools-login> "bash -ic 'proxy_on >/dev/null 2>&1; cd /data/feasibility/E8 && nohup /root/continual-alf-prep-20260928/env/bin/python scripts2/e8_arm_id.py evaluate --bench searchqa --runs 0,1 --cap 1900000 > followup-id/eval_searchqa.log 2>&1 &'" ; OfficeQA, ~3.0M tokens: the same with --bench officeqa --cap 3200000 and log followup-id/eval_officeqa.log ; then scripts2/e8_arm_id.py analyse. Completing the original OfficeQA run 0 (21 cells, ~0.15M): scripts/e8_pipeline.py evaluate --bench officeqa --runs 0 --cap 3200000
pilot.blocked_by: Not a permission denial: the follow-up arm (seeds + distilled rules) and OfficeQA's second run were not launched because the assignment's 3M-token cap had already been used (3,021,746 tokens by the earlier E8 instance).

risks:
- OfficeQA is underpowered: one run on 67 of 74 items, with a detectable effect of about 17 points. The fold-B harm (CI excludes 0) is one subgroup of a 2-fold split with sign p = 0.07: weak evidence of harm, not established.
- The SearchQA tag-rule reading is post hoc. It applies the card's own stated metric, and both readings are reported.
- One distillation per job, with no re-sampling or prompt variants. The distiller saw the card but not the seeds, so it could not avoid restating them.
- Server-side solver drift. E8's interleaved paired comparisons are internally valid, but E8 numbers are not comparable to v3 or any other day's numbers. The archive itself records a solver behaviour that no longer exists, a general risk for any offline prior.
- The rule-to-seed mapping is my semantic reading, supported by lexical overlap numbers.
- The SearchQA and OfficeQA scorers differ: SearchQA accepts untagged replies, OfficeQA requires the tag. Arms that drop the tag look better on SearchQA than the card's metric allows.
- No per-rule ablation was run, so causal attribution to OA5 for the bare-answer behaviour is inferred, not measured.
cost_estimate:
Spent: 3,021,746 tokens.
- Distillation: 194,566 (3 GLM calls with 187,783 tokens, 14 adjudications with 6,783), about 0.06-0.08M tokens per benchmark section.
- SearchQA: 600 cells, 1,424,676.
- OfficeQA: 201 cells, 1,402,504.
- About 70 minutes of running.

Measured tokens per cell:
- SearchQA: E 1,246, I 3,825, D 2,053.
- OfficeQA: E 5,334, I 9,944, D 5,655.

Follow-ups:
- Complete OfficeQA run 0: about 0.15M.
- OfficeQA run 1 for all three arms: about 1.6M.
- Seeds+rules arm against re-measured seeds: SearchQA 400 cells about 1.7M; OfficeQA 296 cells about 3.0M.
- A drift canary (50 fixed SearchQA items x 2 texts per session): about 0.25M.
recommendation:
1. Do not adopt an archive-distilled warm start as the v5 starting Skill. Keep the task-card seeds (I) as the start: they were best or tied on both benchmarks under every metric.
2. Keep the offline distiller at most as a cheap batch proposer. Its rules go ON TOP of the seeds and are distilled from failures of the current solver (re-measured the same week). They must pass the same acceptance test as any rule (cross-ref D1), with a mandatory format and verbosity guard: tag rate and reply-length shift against the parent.
3. Use the archives as a "known proposal families" list, so the analyst does not re-propose them (E8 re-discovered v3's rejected families). Use them for item difficulty only after re-measurement: 18 of the 42 OfficeQA items "dead" in v3 are solved now.
4. Fix the SearchQA no-tag scorer fallback before any comparison (v4 audit item). Until it is fixed, report both readings.
5. Add a standing drift canary, re-run at the start of each session or step (fixed panel, fixed texts, compare reply length and pass rate), and forbid cross-day comparisons (cross-ref D5, D8, D11). The measured server-side change doubled OfficeQA accuracy for an unchanged request.
6. OfficeQA's 74-item pool cannot resolve effects below about 15 points, so any OfficeQA claim needs more items (cross-ref D6, D12).
7. If the owner wants one more number: run the prepared seeds+rules arm on SearchQA first (about 1.7M tokens). It directly answers whether distilled rules add anything on top of the card.
